metadata.unknown_policy: Literal unknown means missing/unverified; it never means no, zero, free, unrestricted or ineligible.
metadata.deadlines_policy: Latest call found is not necessarily globally latest. Historical deadlines and closed cycles are preserved; programme continuity differs from an open application window.
metadata.coordinate_policy: Degrees east-positive, metres. Registry/site proxies explicitly labelled; original official values retained where present. Ideal declination bounds are derived geometry, not actual pointing permission.
